page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz, supported by a 40 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via a single integrated NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage, and network performance is defined by a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the CPU and memory subsystems operate in lower performance tiers compared to modern hardware. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is rated in the bottom 10%, while multi-core performance falls in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests, including read-only large block and write large block operations, consistently rank in the bottom 25%. Passmark CPU testing places the instance in the middle 50% overall, though specific subtests like encryption, physics, and database operations score in the bottom 25%. Redis SET operations achieve 5.48 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput is measured at 6.06 GB/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge offers an entry-level GPU-accelerated profile. Because it utilizes older Intel Xeon Broadwell and NVIDIA Pascal architectures, it represents a budget-friendly option for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the premium cost of current-generation GPU architectures. This instance is suited for legacy GPU-accelerated applications, light machine learning inference, video transcoding, and basic parallel processing tasks that do not demand high-speed local storage or high network throughput.
